$comment: A push_button in series with two 1 kohm resistors across 5 V, pressed for the middle of three 20 ms phases and released for the last.

By hand: open, the divider carries nothing and every node below the button is 0 V. Closed, the button is 1 mohm (the switch family's contact), so 5 V falls over 2000.001 ohm and the middle node (r1 to r2) is 5 * 1000 / 2000.001 = 2.499999 V with 2.5 mA in both resistors.
phase 0  closed 0 (open)      middle node 0 V, 0 mA
phase 1  closed 1 (pressed)   middle node 2.499999 V, 2.5 mA
phase 2  closed 0 (released)  middle node 0 V, 0 mA
The dynamics are none (no capacitor), so the harness's 1 ms classic step is exact. test/core/promoted-kinds-fixtures.test.ts checks these values on both engines.
